text: Aster, Nov. 13 — Stradal Group acquired Fennimore Optics in a deal valued at about 860 million credits, according to people familiar with the matter. The transaction, completed late Tuesday, gives Stradal control of Fennimore’s precision lens division and its two fabrication sites in the Aster belt, said the people, who asked not to be named because the terms were not public. Fennimore’s chief executive, Liora Venn, is expected to remain in place through a transition period ending in February, one of the people said. Stradal has been seeking to expand its industrial imaging business after a year of steady sales gains in remote-sensing equipment.
